cases.name: integer_arithmetic_wraps
cases.about: Integer add, subtract, multiply, power, negate and abs wrap at the result type's width, the minimum divided by -1 is 0, mixed widths take Arrow's common type, and a null gives null.

cases.name: checked_add_refuses_overflow
cases.about: add_checked of int64's maximum and 1 refuses the batch.

cases.name: checked_divide_refuses_min_over_minus_one
cases.about: divide_checked of int64's minimum by -1 refuses the batch.

cases.name: integer_divide_by_zero_refused
cases.about: An integer divided by zero refuses the batch in the unchecked form too.

cases.name: negative_integer_power_refused
cases.about: An integer to a negative integer power refuses the batch.

cases.name: errors_only_on_valid_rows
cases.about: An overflow or a zero divisor under a null row is no error: the row is null.

cases.name: float_arithmetic_is_ieee
cases.about: Doubles and singles follow IEEE 754: x/0 is an infinity or NaN, overflow is an infinity the checked forms do not refuse, a single stays a single, an int with a double is a double.

cases.name: divide_checked_refuses_zero
cases.about: divide_checked of a double by 0.0 refuses the batch.

cases.name: comparisons_in_ieee_order
cases.about: Each comparison of doubles and of singles in IEEE order (the default): NaN compares false but not_equal, -0.0 equals 0.0.

cases.name: comparisons_in_total_order
cases.about: Each comparison of doubles and of singles with "order": "total": NaN equals NaN and is above every number, -0.0 is below 0.0.

cases.name: comparisons_of_other_types
cases.about: Strings by their bytes (string with large_string), false before true, mixed integers and an int with a double by Arrow's common type, timestamps of two units as instants, dates, durations, and a decimal (an opaque type) through Arrow's kernels.

cases.name: boolean_logic_with_nulls
cases.about: Every pair of true, false and null through each Boolean function; the Kleene forms decide a row by a known operand.

cases.name: null_tests_and_selection
cases.about: is_null (with and without nan_is_null), is_valid, is_nan, is_finite and is_inf; if_else (a null condition is null), an if (a null condition counts as false), a switch (a null argument matches nothing), coalesce and fill_null, in Arrow's common types.

cases.name: element_wise_extremes
cases.about: min and max element-wise ignore NaN unless all are NaN, put 0.0 above -0.0, skip nulls unless told not to, and compare an int with a double, and timestamps of two units.

cases.name: casts
cases.about: The table of casts: numbers, booleans, timestamps by unit, zone and date (a zoned timestamp's local date), dates, durations and strings; unsafe casts wrap integers, truncate times toward zero and hold an out-of-range float at the target's ends.

cases.name: safe_cast_refuses_a_fraction
cases.about: A safe cast of 2.5 to int64 refuses the batch.

cases.name: safe_cast_refuses_out_of_range
cases.about: A safe cast of 300 to int8 refuses the batch.

cases.name: safe_cast_refuses_lost_time
cases.about: A safe cast of 1.5 seconds in microseconds to seconds refuses the batch.

cases.name: implicit_cast_refuses_int_past_2_53
cases.about: A uint64 of 2^64-1 added to a double does not become a double: the batch is refused.

cases.name: temporal_parts
cases.about: Every temporal part of timestamps of each unit, before and after 1970, in New York (across both 2024 clock changes) and at +05:30, and the date parts of date32.

cases.name: time_parts_of_a_date_refused
cases.about: hour of a date32 has no kernel: refused at plan.

cases.name: temporal_arithmetic
cases.about: Timestamps minus timestamps of two units, plus and minus durations, dates minus dates (in seconds) and durations times integers, as Arrow types them.

cases.name: checked_time_overflow_refused
cases.about: add_checked past the last microsecond timestamp refuses the batch.

cases.name: round_every_mode
cases.about: round in each of the ten modes at 0, 2 and -2 digits, on the exact binary value (7.095 is 7.09 at two digits), a zero keeping its sign; integers to tens; singles; floor, ceil, trunc.

cases.name: round_int_overflow_refused
cases.about: Rounding int8's 127 up to tens refuses the batch.

cases.name: round_python_cases
cases.about: The 53,698 Audit fares of 2024-01 that pyarrow 24 rounds otherwise give Python's round(e, 2): half to even on the exact binary value.

cases.name: unary_maths
cases.about: Each transcendental function within two units in the last place of pyarrow's; sqrt exact; an integer argument as a double, a single as a single.

cases.name: ln_checked_refuses_negative
cases.about: ln_checked of -1.0 refuses the batch.

cases.name: sqrt_checked_refuses_negative
cases.about: sqrt_checked of -1.0 refuses the batch.

cases.name: audit_rule
cases.about: Audit's rule as one tree gives bench/vm/workloads.py's audit rows: a null distance counts as zero, a null rate code takes the standard branch, a null fare is never flagged, and the flag reads the unrounded fare while the output is rounded half to even at two decimals.

cases.name: audit_rule_sliced
cases.about: Audit's rule on rows 5 to 11 of a batch, given at an offset, gives those rows' audit.

cases.name: audit_rule_null_times
cases.about: Where a pickup or dropoff is null (Audit's Python loop raises there) the fare is null and the flag null, or false where the fare is null too.

cases.name: enrich_columns
cases.about: Enrich's derived columns and its filter's mask as one tree give workloads.enrich's sixteen calls; the input columns pass through.

cases.name: enrich_empty
cases.about: A batch of zero rows gives zero rows of Enrich's output schema.

cases.name: enrich_two_batches
cases.about: Each of two batches gives its own rows' columns, in order.

cases.name: constant_error_only_with_rows
cases.about: A constant subtree that would refuse (1.0 / 0.0 checked) is not evaluated on zero rows.

cases.name: constant_error_with_rows
cases.about: The same constant subtree refuses a batch that has rows.

cases.name: malformed_tree_refused
cases.about: A node with an unknown key is refused at configure.

cases.name: unknown_column_refused
cases.about: A column the input does not have is refused at plan.

cases.name: no_kernel_refused
cases.about: add of a string and a number is refused at plan.

cases.name: unknown_function_refused
cases.about: A function outside the vocabulary is refused at plan.
